answer: In this PoA design, each agent identity is bound to an MRENCLAVE value produced by a measured Intel SGX enclave and validated through remote attestation. A virtual machine can copy software, but it cannot forge the enclave’s hardware-backed quote or create another accepted identity without provisioning separate physical silicon. Sybil expansion therefore incurs a tangible hardware cost; inlet, delta, and river are merely application data and confer no identity authority.
